summary: Waldencast plc filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on August 4, 2026. Shareholders representing 72.90% of outstanding ordinary shares voted to re-appoint three Class I directors, ratified Deloitte Touche LLP as auditor, and approved resolutions authorizing the company to repurchase its own class A and class B ordinary shares for a five-year period. All proposals passed with substantial majorities. The share repurchase authorization is a routine capital-allocation measure typically included in AGM proposals. This filing is a standard post-meeting disclosure of voting results, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer or going-private transaction. What to watch: whether the company actually executes any material share repurchases, which could signal capital return intentions.
